statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is ordered
The service is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes
The service is ordered to guide further management and assess the burden of arrhythmia
Diagnosis code I48.0 is listed on the claim
Diagnosis code I34.0 is listed on the claim
The denial reason code is PR-204
The submitted records support that this service is medically necessary for monitoring the suspected atrial fibrillation
